outcome: long-term cardiac functions (Left ventricular end-diastolic diameter, left ventricular end-systolic diameter, mitral annular plane systolic excursion annulus lateral, tricuspid annular plane systolic excursion Z-scores, echocardiography findings)
cohort: 15 neonates hospitalized with symptomatic COVID-19 infection between January 2020 and May 2023.
finding: A significant percentage of neonates hospitalized with symptomatic COVID-19 showed abnormal cardiac function parameters at 14 months of age, and low neutrophil, platelet counts, and AST levels during infection correlated with abnormal echocardiography findings.
